stdout:
Insert a cuepoint into a live broadcast. Use this tool to insert an ad break cuepoint into a currently live broadcast.

Usage:
  yutu liveBroadcast insertCuepoint [flags]

Examples:
# Insert an ad cuepoint of 30 seconds
yutu liveBroadcast insertCuepoint --ids broadcast123 --cueType cueTypeAd --cueDurationSecs 30
# Insert a cuepoint with offset
yutu liveBroadcast insertCuepoint --ids broadcast123 --cueType cueTypeAd --cueInsertionOffsetMs 5000

Flags:
  -D, --cueDurationSecs int                    Cuepoint duration in seconds
  -O, --cueInsertionOffsetMs int               Cuepoint insertion offset time in milliseconds
  -c, --cueType string                         Cue type (cueTypeAd) (default "cueTypeAd")
  -W, --cueWalltimeMs uint                     Cuepoint wall clock time in milliseconds
  -h, --help                                   help for insertCuepoint
  -i, --ids strings                            IDs of the broadcasts
  -b, --onBehalfOfContentOwner string          ID of the content owner, for YouTube content partners
  -B, --onBehalfOfContentOwnerChannel string   Channel ID for content owner operations
  -o, --output string                          json|yaml|silent
      --yes                                    Confirm the operation
